enriched_activities.activity: Working an overnight shift as a part-time aged-care support worker at the aged-care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning and hydration, and writing detailed progress notes during quiet periods
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the corridor of the aged-care facility. Push the medication and supplies trolley to the first resident's room. Knock on the door frame. Open the door. Walk to the bed. Greet the resident quietly, saying 'Good evening, it's time for a check.' Place a hand on the resident's shoulder. Pull back the blanket. Position a slide sheet under the resident. Bend knees. Grip the slide sheet. Reposition the resident onto the left side. Straighten the pillow. Pull the blanket back over the resident. Pick up the water cup from the bedside table. Hold the cup to the resident's mouth. Return the cup to the table. Write the time and position change into the progress notes folder. Walk to the next room. Repeat repositioning and hydration checks for each resident on the round. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down at the desk. Open the progress notes folder. Write entries in pen for each resident, recording fluid intake, position changes and skin condition. Close the folder. Stand up. Walk back along the corridor for the next hourly round. Wipe down the handrail with a disinfectant cloth. Return the cloth to the trolley.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, checking text-only messages on the phone and planning the day ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Hand over the shift notes to the incoming staff member at the nurses' station. Say 'All residents are settled, notes are in the folder.' Pick up the backpack. Walk out the facility front door. Walk to the train station. Tap the travel card on the reader at the gate. Walk onto the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Board the train. Sit down in a seat by the window. Take the phone out of the backpack. Unlock the phone. Open the messages application. Read two text messages. Type a short reply with both thumbs. Press send. Lock the phone. Put the phone back into the backpack. Stand up at the station announcement. Exit the train. Tap the travel card at the gate. Walk to the bus stop. Board the bus. Tap the travel card. Sit down. Take the phone out again. Open the notes application. Type a list of tasks for the day. Lock the phone. Put the phone away. Stand up. Pull the stop cord. Exit the bus. Walk to the front door of the house.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a quiet light breakfast and a cup of tea, eating slowly and keeping noise to a minimum after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open the front door quietly. Close it slowly with one hand on the handle. Walk to the kitchen. Place the backpack on the floor beside the chair. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and a container of yoghurt. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the bench. Open the cupboard. Take out a bowl and a plate. Close the cupboard door. Pick up a spoon from the drawer. Open the drawer and close it gently. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Pour oats into the bowl. Pour milk over the oats. Open the freezer. Take out a slice of bread. Close the freezer. Place the bread on the plate. Wait for the kettle to click off. Pour hot water into a mug. Place a tea bag into the mug. Stir the tea with the spoon. Carry the bowl, plate and mug to the table. Sit down on the chair. Eat the oats with the spoon. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the dishes to the sink. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up after the night shift, then tidying the sink area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature with the lever. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Lather the arms, torso and legs. Rinse off. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair, face, arms and legs. Hang the towel back on the hook. Wipe the sink with a cloth. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Closing the curtains, turning on the fan for air circulation, setting a phone alarm for the afternoon and writing a short reminder note before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the curtains closed across the window. Press the fan switch on. Adjust the fan head towards the bed. Take the phone out of the backpack. Unlock the phone. Open the alarm application. Set the alarm for 14:15. Press save. Lock the phone. Place the phone on the bedside table. Pick up a pen and a notepad from the desk. Write 'wake 14:15, lunch, laundry, reading' on the notepad. Tear the note off the pad. Press the note onto the bedside table. Take off the slippers. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping to recover from the night shift, keeping the room dark and quiet
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Remain still in bed. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain still in bed. Turn onto the back. Stretch the legs under the blanket. Remain still in bed. Shift the pillow position. Turn onto the left side again. Remain still in bed. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket higher. Remain still in bed. Stir as the alarm begins to ring. Reach out the right arm to the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the alarm stop button. Place the phone back on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a late flexitarian lunch of reheated rice and vegetables, brewing tea and drinking it while sitting quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the container of cooked rice and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. Wait beside the bench. Open the microwave door when it beeps. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Carry the container to the table. Sit down on the chair. Open the container lid. Pick up a fork. Eat the rice and vegetables. Stand up. Carry the empty container to the sink. Place it in the sink. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Close the cupboard. Fill the kettle with water. Press the kettle switch. Place a tea bag in the mug. Pour hot water into the mug when the kettle clicks off. Stir with a spoon. Carry the mug to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea in sips. Stand up. Carry the mug to the sink. Rinse the mug under the tap. Place the mug in the dish rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and starting a load of laundry in the washing machine, then moving it to the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Collect the laundry basket from the corner. Carry the basket to the washing machine. Open the washing machine door. Sort the clothes into the drum. Pour detergent into the dispenser drawer. Close the dispenser drawer. Close the washing machine door. Press the power button. Press the start button. Walk back to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the container and the mug from the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Place them in the dish rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the bench with a cloth. Wait for the washing machine to finish. Open the washing machine door. Pull the wet clothes into the basket. Load the wet clothes into the clothes dryer. Close the dryer door. Press the dryer start button. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on Master of Social Work coursework at the desk, reading assigned articles on the computer monitor and taking structured written notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Press the monitor power button. Wait for the login screen. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the web browser. Open the university library page. Open the first assigned article. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Read the article. Open the notepad file on the screen. Type headings into the document. Type notes under each heading with the keyboard. Switch to the second assigned article. Read the article. Type further notes into the document. Press the keyboard shortcut to save the file. Scroll back to the top of the article. Highlight a paragraph with the mouse. Type a summary line under the notes. Press save again. Close the browser tab. Stand up from the chair. Walk out of the room to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making an afternoon cup of tea, rinsing the used mug and wiping the bench
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Close the cupboard door. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Open the tea tin. Take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Close the tea tin. Pour hot water into the mug when the kettle clicks off. Stir the tea with a spoon. Pick up the mug. Carry it to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the empty mug to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mug under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the mug in the dish rack. Pick up a cloth from the hook. Wipe the bench surface. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth back on the hook. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the weekly budget and cash spending, then sending text-only messages to confirm the next day's plans in writing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the desk drawer. Take out the budget notebook and a pen. Close the drawer. Open the notebook to the current week's page. Pick up the pen. Write the amount of cash spent into each dated row. Add the column of figures on the page with the pen. Write the total in the summary box. Compare the total against the weekly limit written at the top of the page. Write the difference below the total. Close the notebook. Place the notebook and pen back into the drawer. Close the drawer. Take the phone out of the backpack. Unlock the phone. Open the messages application. Open the first contact's thread. Type a message confirming the time and place for the next day. Press send. Open the second contact's thread. Type a message confirming the meeting point. Press send. Read the two replies. Lock the phone. Place the phone on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker, then washing up and putting dishes away
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out tofu, vegetables and a container of rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the bench. Open the cupboard. Take out a frying pan. Close the cupboard. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the knife from the block. Cut the tofu into cubes on the chopping board. Cut the vegetables into strips. Slide the tofu into the pan with the knife. Stir the tofu with a spatula. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the mixture. Add the rice to the pan. Stir until heated through. Press the induction cooker power button off. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Spoon the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Eat the meal with a fork. Stand up. Carry the plate and fork to the sink. Turn on the tap. Wash the plate, fork, pan, knife and chopping board. Turn off the tap. Place the items in the dish rack. Open the cupboard. Put the dry dishes away. Close the cupboard. Wipe the bench with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Chairing the weekly house meeting from a written agenda, updating the shared chore roster and confirming quiet hours and rent and bill due dates
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the clipboard with the written agenda from the bench. Carry it to the kitchen table. Sit down at the table. Place the clipboard in front of the body. Call the other household members to the table, saying 'Meeting starting, everyone please sit down.' Wait for the household members to sit down. Read the first agenda item aloud from the clipboard. Write down the points raised in the margin with a pen. Ask 'Does everyone agree with this?' Read the second agenda item aloud. Turn to the chore roster sheet. Pick up the pen. Write the name of each household member beside a chore for the coming week. Read the roster aloud to the table. Ask 'Is this fair for everyone?' Read the third agenda item aloud. Confirm the quiet hours by reading the times aloud. Confirm the rent due date by reading the date aloud. Confirm the bill due date by reading the date aloud. Write the agreed dates at the bottom of the agenda sheet. Ask 'Any other items?' Wait for responses. Say 'Meeting closed.' Stand up. Pin the chore roster back onto the wall board. Place the clipboard on the bench.

enriched_activities.activity: Folding dry laundry and running the dehumidifier in the bathroom while organising washing supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the clothes dryer door. Pull the dry laundry out into the basket. Close the dryer door. Place the basket on the bathroom floor. Bend down. Pick up one item from the basket. Fold it in half. Fold the sleeves inwards. Place the folded item on the shelf. Pick up the next item. Fold it. Place it on the shelf. Continue folding the remaining items and stacking them on the shelf. Press the dehumidifier power button on. Press the mode button. Pull the water tank out of the dehumidifier. Empty the tank into the sink. Slide the tank back into the dehumidifier. Open the cupboard under the sink. Straighten the bottles of detergent and softener. Close the cupboard door. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking the desk lamp and reorganising study materials and reminders for the coming week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch to test it. Press the switch again. Pull the lamp arm forward to adjust the angle. Straighten the stack of printed articles on the desk. Sort the articles into date order. Place them into a document tray. Pick up the pens from the desk. Place them into the pen holder. Pick up the sticky notes. Write 'Monday reading, Tuesday placement, Wednesday meeting' on a sticky note. Press the note onto the edge of the monitor. Open the desk drawer. Take out a highlighter. Place the highlighter into the pen holder. Close the drawer. Wipe the desk surface with a cloth. Fold the cloth. Place the cloth on the shelf. Stand up. Straighten the chair against the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting a social work assignment at the desk on the computer, following a written task list to stay on track
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down on the chair at the desk. Pick up the written task list from the desk. Read the first item on the list aloud. Press the computer power button. Press the monitor power button. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the word processor. Open the saved assignment file. Place the task list beside the keyboard. Type the introduction paragraph on the keyboard. Read the typed paragraph. Move the cursor with the mouse. Delete a sentence. Type a replacement sentence. Scroll down the document. Type the first body section under the heading. Open a second browser window. Search for a reference on the library page. Copy the citation text. Paste the citation into the document. Type the reference into the reference list at the end of the file. Scroll back to the body section. Type the next paragraph. Press the save shortcut. Pick up the task list. Tick the first two items off with a pen. Type the second body section. Scroll through the whole document. Press the save shortcut again. Close the word processor window. Stand up from the chair. Stretch both arms above the head.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and changing into sleep clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the soap. Lather the hands. Wipe the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush under the tap. Turn off the tap. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Take the sleep clothes from the hook. Take off the day clothes. Fold the day clothes. Place them into the laundry basket. Put on the sleep clothes. Pick up the dirty clothes from the floor. Place them into the laundry basket. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed with the light off and the fan on low, doing a short breathing routine and then falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Reach out the right arm. Press the bedside lamp switch off. Press the fan speed button to the low setting. Place both hands on the abdomen. Inhale through the nose for four counts. Exhale through the mouth for six counts. Repeat the breathing cycle five times. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Place the hand under the pillow. Remain still in bed. Turn onto the left side. Remain still in bed. Close both eyes. Remain still and asleep in bed.
